signup: User fills email + password (12+ chars) + Turnstile CAPTCHA on /auth/signup
Supabase sends confirmation email with magic link to emailRedirectTo: /auth/callback
User clicks link → /auth/callback exchanges token → session cookie set
login: User fills email + password + Turnstile CAPTCHA on /auth/login
Middleware: 4 POST attempts per 15min per IP (in-memory)
POST /api/auth/login — rate check (5/15min/IP Upstash) → supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() server-side
On auth failure: always returns 'Invalid email or password.' — no provider message leakage
If mfaRequired: returns { mfaRequired: true } → browser shows TOTP screen
On MFA pass: POST /api/sessions/register → trust token stored
oauth: User clicks 'Continue with Google' → supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth() from browser
Redirect to Google → back to /auth/callback with code
Supabase exchanges code for session → cookies set
session_management: All requests: middleware calls supabase.auth.getUser() to refresh expiring tokens
IdleTimer: logs out after idle_timeout_minutes (configurable per user)
Trusted devices: 30-day trust token skips MFA step-up
User can revoke all sessions from /settings/revoke-sessions

invoice_send: User creates invoice on /invoice with line items, client info, due date
POST /api/invoices saves as 'draft' in invoices + line_items tables
Server generates unique share_token, builds HTML email via Resend
Email contains invoice details + /i/[share_token] viewer link
Client visits /i/[share_token] → view_count incremented, viewed_at set
Client downloads PDF via html2pdf.js in browser — no server needed
client_portal: User creates client → system generates portal_token (16 random bytes, hex-encoded)
Token stored in clients.portal_token with expiry = now + portal_validity_days
Client visits → server validates token against clients table (service_role)
Fetches all invoices for that client → shows grouped by currency
estimate_lifecycle: User creates estimate on /estimates/new with negotiation options and line items
Resend emails client with review link: /estimates/[id]/review?token=[client_token]
Client visits review page → can Approve or Revise (propose new prices/remove items)
If Approve → status 'approved' → owner can convert to invoice
If Revise → status 'revised' → owner can accept or reject negotiation
Accept negotiation → line items updated → estimate re-sent to client
Convert → POST /api/estimates/[id]/convert → new invoice created → status 'converted'

rate_limiting.middleware: Login POST: 4/15min/IP (in-memory, resets on cold start)

security.mfa: TOTP via Supabase MFA (AAL2). Backup codes hashed with crypto.randomBytes(). Trusted device tokens (30-day).
security.audit_log: All sensitive actions logged to audit_logs via service_role (users cannot forge entries)
security.csp_phase: Report-only (Phase 1). Known violations: wasm-eval (Next.js/Turbopack), vercel.live (preview only). Enforcement deferred until sufficient violation data collected.
security.password_policy: Minimum 12 characters, enforced on client AND server (/api/auth/signup)

middleware.auth_logic: supabase.auth.getUser() on every request — refreshes session cookie automatically. Protected routes redirect to /auth/login (or 401 for API routes).
middleware.matcher: All paths except _next/static, _next/image, favicon, and image files
